name: browser_get_devtools_data
description: Retrieve real-time Chrome DevTools inspection data including Console logs, Network requests, and Performance metrics (JS Heap, DOM nodes, styles, layout)

tabId.description: Optional Tab ID. If omitted, uses the tab controlled by the agent or active tab

type.description: Data type to retrieve: 'all' (default), 'console' (logs/warnings/errors/traces), 'network' (HTTP requests/responses/failures), or 'performance' (JS heap size, node count, layout/style calculations)

limit.description: Maximum number of console log or network entries to return (default: 50, max: 200)

clear.description: Optional: Clear buffer after reading so subsequent calls only return new events (default: false)
